description.value: The Bayside Restaurant & Lounge is the signature dining room of the Bayside Oceanfront Resort, a full-service oceanfront hotel in Parksville. The kitchen spotlights local ingredients through a rotating seasonal menu supported by an extensive cocktail and wine program. Weekend evenings feature free live music, and a dedicated Sunday brunch service makes it a sociable stop for cyclists passing through town.
